# Switching from the merge to the rebase restack method
# replays only the branch's own commits onto its base:
# no merge commit and no duplicated base content.
# Covered after trunk advances and after trunk is amended.

as 'Test <test@example.com>'
at '2024-05-27T18:24:42Z'

mkdir repo
cd repo
git init
git add init.txt
git commit -m 'Initial commit'
gs repo init

# create a feature branch that doesn't conflict with trunk.
cp $WORK/extra/feature.txt feature.txt
git add feature.txt
gs bc -m feature

# advance trunk and merge-restack feature onto it.
gs trunk
cp $WORK/extra/init.v2.txt init.txt
git add init.txt
git commit -m 'Change init'

gs up
git config spice.restack.method merge
gs branch restack

# feature now has a merge commit with trunk as its second parent.
git graph --branches
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/graph.merge1.txt

# advance trunk again with an ordinary new commit,
# then switch back to the rebase method and restack.
gs trunk
cp $WORK/extra/init.v3.txt init.txt
git add init.txt
git commit -m 'Change init again'

gs up
git config spice.restack.method rebase
gs branch restack

# feature is a linear rebase of its own commit onto trunk:
# no merge commit, and trunk's commits were not duplicated onto it.
git graph --branches
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/graph.rebase1.txt
git log --format='%s' feature
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/log.rebase1.txt

gs ll -a
cmp stderr $WORK/golden/ll1.txt

cmp feature.txt $WORK/extra/feature.txt
cmp init.txt $WORK/extra/init.v3.txt

# repeat, but amend trunk instead of advancing it before the rebase restack.
gs trunk
cp $WORK/extra/init.v3b.txt init.txt
git add init.txt
git commit -m 'Change init once more'

gs up
git config spice.restack.method merge
gs branch restack

git graph --branches
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/graph.merge2.txt

gs trunk
cp $WORK/extra/init.v4.txt init.txt
git add init.txt
git commit --amend -m 'Change init once more (amended)'

gs up
git config spice.restack.method rebase
gs branch restack

# feature is still a linear rebase of only its own commit,
# now onto the rewritten trunk commit.
git graph --branches
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/graph.rebase2.txt
git log --format='%s' feature
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/log.rebase2.txt

cmp feature.txt $WORK/extra/feature.txt
cmp init.txt $WORK/extra/init.v4.txt

-- repo/init.txt --
initial init

-- extra/init.v2.txt --
changed init

-- extra/init.v3.txt --
changed init again

-- extra/init.v3b.txt --
changed init once more

-- extra/init.v4.txt --
changed init once more (amended)

-- golden/graph.merge1.txt --
*   f1d0d64 (HEAD -> feature) Merge branch 'main' into feature
|\  
| * 57ab3b0 (main) Change init
* | 408904f feature
|/  
* d692027 Initial commit
-- golden/graph.rebase1.txt --
* ccb1cf1 (HEAD -> feature) feature
* ded3954 (main) Change init again
* 57ab3b0 Change init
* d692027 Initial commit
-- golden/log.rebase1.txt --
feature
Change init again
Change init
Initial commit
-- golden/ll1.txt --
┏━━■ feature ◀
┃    ccb1cf1 feature (now)
main
-- golden/graph.merge2.txt --
*   1523f9e (HEAD -> feature) Merge branch 'main' into feature
|\  
| * 1a87d27 (main) Change init once more
* | ccb1cf1 feature
|/  
* ded3954 Change init again
* 57ab3b0 Change init
* d692027 Initial commit
-- golden/graph.rebase2.txt --
* d30f7ac (HEAD -> feature) feature
* d01c50a (main) Change init once more (amended)
* ded3954 Change init again
* 57ab3b0 Change init
* d692027 Initial commit
-- golden/log.rebase2.txt --
feature
Change init once more (amended)
Change init again
Change init
Initial commit
-- extra/feature.txt --
feature contents
